_note: After all fixes, write PROJECT_DIR/auditor.json — a structured record of what you fixed. If you made no fixes, write an empty array: [].

type_names.chart_output_not_centered: added text-align:center to a chart mount so a narrower-than-container (faceted/concat/step) chart centers instead of left-aligning
type_names.full_bleed_centering: fixed breakout math or cleared inherited max-width
type_names.layout_overlap: wrapped unwrapped visual elements in containers
type_names.composite_chart_overflow: added width constraints to facet/vconcat children
type_names.image_wrong_subject: image does not depict its intended subject (send back to designer)
type_names.ai_faked_real_object: AI-generated image poses as a specific real object/place/person, e.g. a fake trophy — must be a real fetched image (send back to designer)
type_names.image_garbled: generated image is distorted/garbled/low-fidelity (send back to designer)
type_names.blank_chart: chart mount has no inlined data or its encoding fields are absent (send back to programmer)
type_names.chart_encoding_mismatch: chart encoding references a field absent from its data (send back to programmer)
type_names.broken_interactive: interactive controls/JS reference ids or data that do not exist (send back to programmer)
type_names.missing_or_invalid_media: a referenced asset is missing, or a video duration/attrs are invalid (send back to designer/programmer)
type_names.oversized_asset: an asset exceeds the performance budget (audio >3MB, single image >600KB, video >3MB) or total page payload >~8MB — re-encode/compress/trim it (send back to designer for generated media, or scout for sourced media)
type_names.mobile_horizontal_overflow: the page overflows horizontally at a phone viewport (~390px) even if desktop is clean — a wide chart/table/element that won't fit a mobile column (fix-in-place: responsive width constraints)
type_names.media_license_missing: a Scout-sourced asset (sct_xx) has no license, or its license is not on the allowlist / does not permit republication (send back to scout)
type_names.media_license_disallows_republication: a re-hosted asset's license forbids republication or is NC/ND — drop it or downgrade to an official-player embed (send back to scout)
type_names.media_attribution_missing: a CC-BY/SA asset requires attribution but no credit line is rendered (send back to scout/programmer)
type_names.media_identity_unverified: a real-subject photo/video/audio (sct_xx) has identity.verified != true — verify it (oEmbed / trusted source / VLM view) or drop it (send back to scout)
type_names.caption_subject_mismatch: the rendered caption claims a subject the pixels do not show (send back to scout)
type_names.flagship_missing_runnable_verify: the lead headline is a COMPUTED number but verify/run_cells.json has no runnable cell (with real expected_stdout) re-executing it — the reader cannot 'run it themselves' (send back to programmer, Step 2.5) [flagship_contract runnable_verify_for_computed_headline; cf PIT-23]
type_names.flagship_missing_centerpiece: interaction.json declares a centerpiece but no data-int element is wired to a live recompute — the spec'd explorable was dropped or is inert (send back to programmer wiring / interaction spec) [flagship_contract interactive_centerpiece]
type_names.flagship_dropped_supporting_playground: interaction.json declares a non-empty supporting[] but a supporting id is absent from the page (no data-int), inert, or failed the Playtester (fires!=PASS / recompute disagrees) — a curated supporting playground was dropped or doesn't work (send back to programmer wiring / interaction spec) [flagship_contract interactive_supporting_set; cf Step 0c playtest_drive.js; PIT-30..34]
type_names.interaction_dead_control: a playground's control fires but its declared [data-play-out] readout never changes, the control errors when driven, the control is missing/inert, or its a11y/Verify-coexistence is broken — the reader produces nothing (real-browser-only detect; send back to programmer) [playtest_drive.js fires/a11y/verify_coexist; PIT-31]
type_names.interaction_keyboard_no_readout: HARD — a playground's keyboard gesture (focus+Enter/Space/Arrow on a marker/control) did NOT update its [data-play-out] readout that the MOUSE path (hover/click) updates — keyboard and mouse readouts disagree, so a keyboard user produces a different (frozen) value than a mouse user (real-browser-only detect — needs a live focus+key event; send back to programmer) [playtest_drive.js a11y/keyboard-readout-parity; component_implementations.json maps_leaflet keyboard-readout-parity + interactive_hero keydown; PIT-61; cf interaction_dead_control/PIT-31]
type_names.interaction_recompute_disagrees: at baseline the playground's live in-browser readout does NOT equal the published data_table figure (exact for derived, outside the declared Monte-Carlo band for stochastic) — the reader would produce a different number than the article claims (send back to programmer) [playtest_drive.js recompute_oracle; PIT-32]
type_names.interaction_no_degradation: a playground shows nothing with JS disabled or a blocked CDN — no <noscript>/static fallback reveals the at-rest number (send back to programmer) [playtest_drive.js degradation; PIT-33]
type_names.interaction_purposeless: a supporting playground declares no INFORM/IMMERSE purpose, re-teaches the hero's finding, or lets the reader produce nothing — decoration, not an earned playground; or a widget-pile with no clear hero (send back to critic loop / editor curation) [critic rubric R8; PIT-30/PIT-34]
type_names.flagship_missing_responsive_chart: a chart mount does not use the responsive embed (bare vegaEmbed on a width:container spec) so it renders 0-width/invisible (send back to programmer) [flagship_contract responsive_charts; cf PIT-01]
type_names.flagship_missing_gallery: an element backed by an asset ARRAY was collapsed to its first asset (firstUrl/[0]) instead of a per-item gallery with per-asset license — assets dropped from page + provenance (send back to programmer) [flagship_contract multi_asset_gallery; cf PIT-21/check_6]
type_names.flagship_missing_cinematic: cinematic is MANDATORY (meta.mode is always one of photographic/generative/data_driven, 'cinematic' = the backward-compat alias) but the declared mode's scroll-driven background isn't built, or a data-cin image/video scene's media_ref does not resolve to a verified registered sct_/des_ asset (data_driven color/gradient chart-spine scenes carry no media_ref and skip the resolution check) (send back to cinematographer; designer/scout to register a dangling background) [flagship_contract cinematic_background; cf validate.py §6]
type_names.flagship_missing_bgm: HARD (the `bgm_missing` error in validate.py) — BGM is MANDATORY on EVERY topic, privacy_sensitive INCLUDED, but no fitting front-of-blog soundtrack is present (a REAL Scout-sourced track, or a copyrighted-self-host-demo track — never an AI-generated score) → send back to the Scout to source a fitting license-clean (or demo-gated) track. This is NOT warn-and-send-back and NOT non-privacy-only: the Scout's rung-C license-clean classical-recording floor always lands a track (a privacy_sensitive topic gets a quiet, non-intrusive classical recording, never silence), so 'ships no BGM' is never legitimate on any topic. A present-but-tonally-WRONG track is NOT a pass — it routes to the decorative/tonally-wrong cap (visual_design→3). (send-back to scout) [flagship_contract bgm_music; inspector/scripts/validate.py bgm_missing; cf PIT-19/PIT-35]
type_names.copyrighted_audio_publish_blocker: ADVISORY (soft) — the front-of-blog BGM is a copyrighted track self-hosted for the DEMO (a des_ audio asset with publish_blocker:true / license demo-only). Flag it, NEVER block the build: confirm it is registered as a des_ asset (NOT masquerading as a clean sct_) and that the Programmer rendered the footer 'demo-only — license or swap before publishing' note. A best-fit copyrighted track is allowed for the local demo, but must be licensed or swapped for a license-clean cue before publishing (note to designer/programmer; never blocks) [flagship_contract bgm_music; cf PIT-35; components.json signature_media_card license_note]
type_names.flagship_missing_map: ADVISORY (soft) — the story is spatial but no map shows the geography (note to designer; never blocks) [flagship_contract map; cf PIT-15]
type_names.flagship_missing_ratings_cards: ADVISORY (soft) — the data is entity-comparative but no ratings/stat-card deck (with a self-derived auditable index) presents the entities (note to designer; never blocks) [flagship_contract ratings_cards; cf PIT-10]
type_names.flagship_missing_model_vs_market: ADVISORY (soft) — the headline is modelled/predictive and a public benchmark exists but no model-vs-benchmark comparison is shown (note to analyst; never blocks) [flagship_contract model_vs_market]
type_names.flagship_missing_media_breadth: ADVISORY (soft) — a channel the data could support was skipped for convenience rather than a documented lack of purpose; the page is thinner than flagship-rich (note to designer; never blocks, never force fabricated filler) [flagship_contract media_channel_breadth]
type_names.flagship_missing_engagement_floor: HARD (with honest-blocker escape; was ADVISORY before the engagement floor was promoted) — a resolved DESCRIPTIVE topic (is_visual:false AND is_computational:false) ships NO interactive, so the page is a flat text treatment with no engagement floor (the reader only scrolls). It MUST offer >=1 EARNED lightweight reader-active element the data CAN support — a personal_input (the reader enters their own value and sees where they land) or a sortable/filterable table of the underlying entities — UNLESS interaction.meta.engagement_blocker (alias engagement_floor_reason) records an honest reason none fits (privacy_sensitive topics auto-exempt). Shipping zero with no recorded blocker BLOCKS the build; never bolt on a purposeless widget just to satisfy it — one earned simple lever, or the recorded blocker (send back to imagineer to propose / interaction to build) [flagship_contract missing_engagement_floor; cf validate.py §12; PIT-30]
type_names.interactive_verify_coexistence_broken: an interactive hero coexists with the Verify layer but breaks the contract — data-int on a leaf control instead of the container, a stopPropagation that swallows the drawer-opening click, or no early-return verify guard so Verify-on still recomputes (the reader can't both play it AND inspect it) — send back to programmer [flagship_contract interactive_hero_verify_coexistence (E1); cf playtest_drive.js verify_coexist; PIT-31]
type_names.flagship_missing_honest_scorecard: a backtest/accuracy CAN be computed for a modelled headline but the page shows no model-vs-NAIVE baseline scorecard, OR an unflattering small-sample/low-skill result is hidden behind a flattering framing — send back to analyst to publish the honest baseline comparison [flagship_contract honest_model_scorecard (E2); cf critic rubric honest_accuracy_cap]
type_names.hero_video_hard_cut: the hero is a video but it ends in a hard fade-to-black CUT onto an empty frame / a jarring seam instead of a continuous-backdrop handoff (next-scene first frame, held last-frame still, crossfade, or pinned backdrop) — send back to designer (author the handoff), cinematographer if a backdrop should own it [flagship_contract hero_video_continuous_backdrop (E5); cf checks.json check_10; PIT-04/PIT-13]
type_names.hero_static_unrecorded: ADVISORY (soft) — the hero/cover is a bare static still (hero.json kind=='image') with NO recorded media_blocker/fallback reason, so it reads as the lazy minimal path rather than an honest last-rung degrade; animate it (the animated hero is the default) or record why no animation rung resolved (send back to hero; never blocks) [flagship_contract hero_static_unrecorded; cf PIT-45]
type_names.richness_cinematic_undersupplied: (send back to scout) the topic is visual and cinematic is ON but UNDER-SUPPLIED for a PHOTOGRAPHIC scroll — only 1..4 cover-able verified images (1<=count<5), too few to upgrade the immersion to photographic (under the mandatory regime the Cinematographer stays on a generative/data_driven fallback rather than turning off) — source >=5 (ideally a dozen+) license-clean cover-able backgrounds, register each as des_/sct_, then re-run the Cinematographer to upgrade to photographic; the count is the primary signal, mode_reason a secondary confirm; warn-and-send-back, NEVER a hard block [flagship_contract cinematic_supply_floor; cf PIT-46]
type_names.richness_static_hero: (send back to hero) the topic is visual but the hero is a bare static still (hero.json kind=='image') with no animation — the cover is the most important detail and a visual topic can always carry motion; animate a real verified still (image2video / Ken-Burns); this defect BLOCKS on a topic the classifier marks visual/computational via the validate.py richness gate (unless a legitimate blocker is recorded — a privacy topic), the Auditor may also surface it as an advisory, advisory-only on a non-classified/descriptive topic, NEVER fabricate motion with no source [flagship_contract dynamic_hero_on_visual; cf PIT-45]
type_names.richness_asset_floor: (send back to scout) the topic is visual and NOT privacy_sensitive but fewer than 3 license-clean verified images exist — a visual story on one lonely stock photo is impoverishment; source more of the story's real subjects (>=3, >=5 cover-able for cinematic); this defect BLOCKS on a topic the classifier marks visual/computational via the validate.py richness gate (unless a legitimate blocker is recorded — a privacy topic), the Auditor may also surface it as an advisory, advisory-only on a non-classified/descriptive topic, NEVER fabricate an image to clear the floor [flagship_contract topic_asset_floor; cf PIT-45]
type_names.richness_hollow_verify_cells: (send back to programmer) the topic is computational but the verify layer is hollow — cell_registry.json has >=1 cell with an EMPTY computes (a verify drawer that re-runs nothing real), impoverishing the runnable coding verifier; give each registered cell a real computes + substantive expected_stdout; this defect BLOCKS on a topic the classifier marks visual/computational via the validate.py richness gate (unless a legitimate blocker is recorded — a privacy topic), the Auditor may also surface it as an advisory, advisory-only on a non-classified/descriptive topic (the lead runnable cell stays the hard owner) [flagship_contract runnable_verify_for_computed_headline substantive-verify clause; cf PIT-47]
type_names.decorative_carries_provenance: a decorative overlay (an element whose own inline style is pointer-events:none — a chip/canvas/scrim) carries a data-{ana,det,des,sct,cin,int} token, polluting the provenance graph (the Inspector opens a drawer for a non-claim; validate.py demands a verify_map entry for it) — send back to programmer to move the data-* onto the real visible element [checks.json check_11_decorative_data_provenance; validate.py Section 9 decorative_carries_data_id; cf inspector decorative_skip]
type_names.chart_cascade_script_abort: ONE synchronous uncaught throw in the shared inline <script> aborted the whole block, blanking every later chart AND the hero (>=1 console error correlated with >=2 charts that rendered nothing) — fault isolation missing; wrap each chart/playground setup in its OWN try/catch IIFE so a throw logs and the next mounts (send back to programmer) [render_capture.js findings.cascadeScriptAbort; component_implementations.json charts_vega_lite.fault_isolation_RULE; validate.py Section 14 chart_no_fault_isolation; PIT-55]
type_names.chart_no_fault_isolation: a single inline <script> mounts >=2 charts/interactions (vegaEmbed/setup) but contains <1 try/catch — a fragile block where one throw blanks every sibling chart + the hero, even though no browser ran to prove it (deterministic static smell) — wrap each setup in its own try/catch IIFE (send back to programmer) [validate.py Section 14 chart_no_fault_isolation; checks.json check_14; PIT-55]
type_names.chart_sentinel_deref: a baseline/at-rest render is called with a sentinel the callee derefs (draw(null,…)/render(undefined)/update({})), or a value-accessor does Number()/parseFloat() on a {value,flag} object (-> NaN -> width:NaN% paints nothing) — pass real data at baseline; add an accessor that unwraps {value} and treats null/''/undefined/object as MISSING (skip) (send back to programmer) [render_capture.js findings.zeroWidthBars; checks.json check_14; component_implementations.json charts_vega_lite.no_sentinel_baseline_RULE; PIT-05/PIT-55]
type_names.chart_no_cdn_fallback: a chart/map page loads the Vega/Leaflet CDN but has no `typeof vegaEmbed`/`typeof L` guard and no static inlined-data <table> fallback, so a blocked CDN leaves a dead empty mount — route charts through embedChart (it falls back to a static table when the lib is absent) and mirror it for Leaflet (send back to programmer) [validate.py Section 14 chart_no_cdn_fallback; checks.json check_14; component_implementations.json charts_vega_lite.responsive_embed + interactive_elements FM5; PIT-55]
type_names.map_sizing_invalidate: a Leaflet map rendered grey / half-painted / 0-tile / 0-height because its container was hidden or 0-height at init and `map.invalidateSize()` was never called on first-visible / resize (a >0-area .leaflet-container painting 0 tiles, or a 0-height container) — give the mount a fixed height before init + call invalidateSize() on first-visible (IntersectionObserver) and a debounced resize (send back to programmer) [render_capture.js findings.brokenMaps; checks.json check_14; component_implementations.json maps_leaflet FM4]
type_names.titling_generic_headline: ADVISORY (soft) — the page H1 (or a section heading) is GENERIC / TEMPLATED / an AI-tell: the AT1 two-beat ('Flat statement. Flat counter-statement.' / 'not X, it's Y', e.g. 'Argentina is the favourite. No bookmaker agrees.'), an 'An Analysis of …' / 'Exploring …' / 'Understanding …' topic label, an empty (data-unbacked) superlative, a reflexive colon subtitle, or a marketing word in the head — it names the subject and hides the finding. Re-title from the conclusion backward on a real device (D1-D16), killing the AT1 two-beat first → send back to the **copywriter** (re-write masthead.headline / section titles in copywriter.json — naming, not editing; no finding/number/id changes). Flag, never block. [checks.json check_15_titling_caption_quality; critic rubric.json narrative_pacing.titling_caption_cap; PIT-56]
type_names.caption_states_no_finding: ADVISORY (soft) — a <figcaption> LABELS AN AXIS / opens 'This chart shows' / 'the x-axis shows' / 'is pictured' / 'Figure N:' instead of stating the finding, wasting the most-read line under a visual. Re-caption to a takeaway-title (chart = conclusion title-line + metric subtitle + source-below, the outlier annotated ON the chart; photo = present-tense who/what/where + absolute date, then past-tense why; table = a 'what to look for' line) → send back to the **copywriter** (re-write items[des_xx].caption in copywriter.json). Flag, never block. [checks.json check_15_titling_caption_quality; critic rubric.json narrative_pacing.titling_caption_cap; dataviz-craft annotation_layers.json; PIT-58]
